notes: Version 2.31 records SG-Note 2.2 and GGS-Note 2.1. Both notes work on a supplied Riemannian metric; its reading as the emergent metric is conditional on the unestablished spatial-limit hypothesis [H-L], the open lifting hypothesis [H-lift], a supplied rank-four extension and a continuation from Riemannian signature that is not performed, and no metric coefficient value is established. SG-Note states the conditions under which the Einstein tensor dominates the renormalized metric variation, with the Einstein coefficient a matching datum, and the conditional stationarity at leading local infrared order. GGS-Note states the Lorentzian continuation as open in the geometric and gauge sectors and types the spectral stratification as an organising reading. The registry entries, table rows, bibliography entries and graph nodes are updated, the emergent-geometry edges to Q12 and Q13 carry the full list of conditions, and two conditional edges from EG-Note to SG-Note and GGS-Note record that only the emergent reading of the metric depends on the geometric branch.
